content: Kalanero Metene Tahi
Haxowaka kahare kalorexe noloxa resebetyaseharenai, exahe haiyaharenai iniyalahare nomaseharenai xoaha kaokaha Jesus ana, semaha maheta iniraine.
Hoka fariseunai, xaotyakiyaho kakoa waiyoreterenai xoaha iraehenaha etahi hoka nexaha: — Exe haliti atyo iniyalahare nomaseharenai koni tyaonita exahe kanakairita ekakoaha.
Hatyaoseta Jesus exakere aemenekotya:
— Hatya xinekonitareya 100-ri kakalaneroxere hoka haliya meta hoka xane ite tawehetehenene, maiha kore ite? Hatyo hiyeta halakisaite 99-ri maseta hoka xane ite tawehetene kaokehetehenerene kijiya.
Kaokeheteniya hoka ihalaharetaiya ekakoa hoka hatyoakolyahoiya kolahetene hoka haikoaheta ekakoa.
Kaokehetaiya ekakoa hahana nali hoka kawisaiya hahinaeharenai, hawaiyaneharenai hoka nexaiya: “Xihalaharehena nokakoi. Nokaokiheta nokalaneroxi mititere”, nexaiya.

— Hatyo hiyeta nomita: hatyo akeretaite kalore ite kaihalaharetyaka enokoa nali, hatya haliti iniyalahare nomasehare halakihenere iniyalahare háomane kakoa, 99-harenai iniyalahare maomaneharenai, koxaka waiyexe wenati xema tyaohetehenerenai xahexe — nexa.
Olo Hokose Metene Tahi

Hatyaoseta Jesus iraehitiya: — Hatya ohiroiya kaoloxolo 10-hokose hoka hahokoseya meta enonita hoka taweheteneya, maisaiya kore? Kaokeheta mahetaiya olo hokose hoka aotakatyaiya xaokanatyakalati, hisakotyaiya hati ako hoka waiyeya taweheta exahita kaokehetehenerene kijiya.
Kaokeheteniya hoka kaixakatyaiya hahinaehalonai, hawaiyanehalonai hoka nexaiya: “Xihalahalohena nokakoi. Nokaokiheta atyo noloxi mititere”, nexaiya.
— Hatyo hiyeta nomita: nikareta tehitiyaite Enore wakaneharenae anjonai ihalahareha, hatya iniyalahare nomasehare halakihena iniyalahare háomane hoka — nexa.
Hatya Haliti Ityani Miyahenere Haxiyehare Tahi
Hoka Jesus nehitiya: — Hatya haliti hinamahare kaisaniye.
Hoka haxowaka ityani xoimere nexa hanexe hiye: “Abá, xama kalikini hisehena nomani holini hixiyehare, noxiyehare maheta”, nexa. Hoka enexeha iraka haxiyeharenai haisaninai ana.
— Hatyaoseta mawaheneta hoka ityani xoimere xakaiharetyoa hoka xane hakoa wenakalati xeta. Hatyo nali wenati iniyalahare xema taita tyaona, exahe miyatya tyotya haxiyeharenai kaxekakehenere enomana.
— Miyahenere tyotya haxiyehare najikinita nakiti tyaona hatyo tyaonitere nali hoka xoimahaliti nakehena.
Hatyaoseta tawa hatya nali tyaoniterenai konitare hoka hakahinaetyaka aoka. Hoka hatya axikatya xoimahaliti hawenakala xeta, ebolokoxanai kaxaiko maheta.
Hoka hatyo nali nakita hoka kasani bolokonai kanakairiterehare kanakaira aokowita, xakore maisa hatyoharenai hekoti isaha enomana aokowiyeha.
— Hatyaoseta kehexaharetyoaheta hoka ahekohena: “Xoanamahare baba wakaneharenai nakaira ala kalikini kamawaneta hoka natyo atyo ali nowainihena nonaki!
Nahaikoahetaite baba hana xeta hoka nomite ihiye: ‘Abá, iniyalahare notyoma Enore ana, exahe hikakoa
hoka maisaiya atyo hityani haohitita natyo. Maika hiwakaneharenai akereta hamoka natyo’, nomite”, nexa.

Hatyaoseta kikisoaheta hatyo nalita hoka haikoaheta hanexe hana xeta. — Xanehititata hoka enexe sekota waiyehetene. Hoka airakoaneharetya haisani hoka tema xane ahalakoatene, xakoloharetene, sohitanakolisene xoaha.
Hoka xoimahaliti nehena: “Abá, iniyalahare notyoma Enore ana, exahe hikakoa hoka maisaiya atyo xoare maheta hityani haohitita natyo”, nexa.
— Xakore hoka enexe wakatya hawakaneharenai: “Xihalahare! Xisohena imiti waiyexe kakoa hoka xaisoakihetene. Kahititini xamoheta ihiye, kijititini harenai.
Exahe xiyane xaisehena bowi mokose kolotere hoka wimaxalohare.
Xiyaiya, exe nityani atyo waini ene hoka kalikini atyo kaseheta. Meta xakore hoka kakaokakeheta”, nexa enexe. Hatyaoseta aokitere akereta tyomaha hoka maxalohareha.
— Hatyo xowaka ityani inityohaliti xaneta mase. Hoka kaokehetehena, owitehetehena mohitita hati hoka sema xerati, xoholikoati nemahare.
Hoka kawisa hatya wakahare hoka axene: “Xoana hoka nikare tyaonaha?” nexa.
Hoka wakahare nexa ihiye: “Hiximarene kinaseta, exahe kinatereta kaokeheta. Hatyo hiyeta hexe bowi mokose kolotere xaisaka aoka”, nexa ihiye.
— Hatyaoseta ityani inityohaliti ehare, maisa isoaheta aokowita hatyako. Hoka enexe hikoa menanaka hoka tihityoa ihiye isoaheta maheta.

Xakore hoka nexa hanexe hiye: “Hiyaiya, waha terehokoanehena wakahare akereta nahakita homana, exahe maisa namasemakiyatyare hiraine. Xakore hoka maisa hali hekoti kabala hisare nomani hoka nomaxaloharexe nohinaeharenai kakoa.
Hoka exe hityani hixiyeharenai tyotya miyahenere enatyalolonai hiye kalikini haikoaheta hoka bowi mokose kolotere xaisaka haoka”, nexa.
— Hatyaoseta enexe nexa ihiye: “Haré, nohaliyi atyo hisaota minita hoka tyotya noxiyeharenai atyo homanere tehitiya.
Hoka exe hisehaliti terota notyoma naokowi, wihalaharene wahotikisa maheta. Hiyaiya, exe hiximarene atyo waini ene hoka kaseheta, meta hoka kakaokakeheta”, nexa haisani hiye.
